SELECT CASE WHEN "o"."ordered_at" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]*' AND date(substr("o"."ordered_at",1,10)) = substr("o"."ordered_at",1,10) THEN strftime('%Y-%m', substr("o"."ordered_at",1,10)) END AS "Month", SUM("o"."amount") AS "Total amount", COUNT(*) AS "Number of rows"
FROM "orders" AS "o"
LEFT JOIN "order_items" AS "i" ON "o"."id" = "i"."order_id"
GROUP BY CASE WHEN "o"."ordered_at" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]*' AND date(substr("o"."ordered_at",1,10)) = substr("o"."ordered_at",1,10) THEN strftime('%Y-%m', substr("o"."ordered_at",1,10)) END
ORDER BY CASE WHEN "o"."ordered_at" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]*' AND date(substr("o"."ordered_at",1,10)) = substr("o"."ordered_at",1,10) THEN strftime('%Y-%m', substr("o"."ordered_at",1,10)) END ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 25 OFFSET 0
